scope: Native window GUI-loop scripted pointer and keyboard input, zero-DOF size-driven rectangle, extrusion preview and commit, parameter edit, undo/redo, save/reopen, named face and topology key checks.
limitations: Input is injected into the application GUI loop, not through operating-system mouse and keyboard events.
Images show the sketch and a front projection; they do not independently establish an isometric 3D presentation.
This is not a BDD scenario receipt or the complete R3 milestone exit.
Sketch solve precision qualification remains open in #3928.
The full gate is blocked by the released API pin mismatch in #3965.
capture_method: The test command ran as a subprocess under the Xvfb wrapper while ImageMagick captured the X root window every three seconds. The logged output is the subprocess output.
